title: Launch eve: GTA has podcasts now
lines: [confident] Welcome to Leonida After Hours, the Full Clear podcast. [pause] I'm Scout, and the whole crew is here.
[confident] Nia here. With the map, obviously.
[confident] Tonight is launch eve. [pause] On PlayStation, the game unlocks at midnight, country by country. And New Zealand went first.
[confident] Before anyone plays: PS5 needs system update 14.23. Sony says it's required. [pause] Plus up to 212 gigabytes of space.
[smug] Which is why my notebook says: delete one old game. [pause] Maybe two.
[confident] Now my favourite news today. [pause] Sony confirmed GTA has on-demand podcasts, for the first time ever. [pause] And you can listen on foot, with earbuds.
[confident] So technically, [pause] we're a podcast about a game that has podcasts.
[smug] Podcast inception. [pause] I'll review the in-game shows as soon as I've heard them.
[confident] Quick debate. [pause] First thing you do in Leonida? I'm driving straight to the Keys for the sunset.
[confident] Wrong. [pause] Vice City, first night, neon, zero plans.
[confident] I'm finding wildlife in Grassrivers. Through the binoculars. From a safe distance.
[smug] And I'm filming all of you failing. [pause] For Leonida Daily.
[confident] Your turn: the Keys, Vice City, or Grassrivers? Tell us in the comments.
[confident] And send your best moments to our Discord. If we use one, your name goes on screen.
[excited] This was Leonida After Hours. [pause] See you on the other side of midnight.
